einzeiler: Jean Chatzky on how women growing wealthier reshapes finance and business
kurzfassung: Jean Chatzky discusses her career transition from journalism to finance and the value of skill stacking in entrepreneurship. She examines the state of the gender wage gap and explains why women are set to control more wealth. Additionally, the episode covers practical financial strategies regarding investing, debt, credit, and homeownership.

beschreibung:
Determined to fix her messy personal finances, Jean Chatzky built a career from journalism to investing on Wall Street and back to financial media, learning how money works. Along the way, she saw a major economic shift taking shape as women began earning, inheriting, and controlling more wealth. So she built HerMoney, a platform helping women become financially empowered. In this episode, Jean shares how this economic shift will reshape investing, relationships, and consumer behavior, plus practical strategies for spending, debt, credit, homeownership, and financial freedom.

In this episode, Hala and Jean will discuss:

(00:00) Introduction

(02:20) Jean’s Transition From Journalism to Finance

(04:13) The Value of Skill Stacking in Entrepreneurship

(07:33) The State of the Gender Wage Gap

(16:10) Why Women Will Control More Wealth

(21:14) Dating as a Successful Woman

(27:52) How Women Are Learning to Invest

(31:15) Financial Freedom, Renting, and Homeownership

(36:51) How Money Types Shape Financial Decisions

(41:20) Budgeting, Debt, and Credit Strategies

(48:40) Investing Extra Cash Wisely

Jean Chatzky is an award-winning journalist and the founder and CEO of HerMoney, a multimedia company dedicated to helping women build financial confidence. She spent 25 years as the financial editor for NBC’s Today show and has served as AARP’s personal finance ambassador. Chatzky is also a New York Times bestselling author and hosts the HerMoney podcast, where she and a team of experts help women take control of their money.
